canvas.$description: Primary shell background with a warm Brand A tint.

raised.$description: Raised card surface separating panels with subtle warmth.

subtle.$description: Secondary panel surface tuned for AA contrast with primary text.

disabled.$description: Disabled surface. Measured 1.76:1 against text.disabled (sRGB-clipped) — deliberately below 3:1, because WCAG 1.4.3 exempts inactive components and the low contrast IS the disabled affordance.

backdrop.$description: Overlay scrim aligned to Brand A neutrals.

inverse.$description: Inverse surface for tooltips and chips on warm panels.

default.$description: Primary interactive background. ΔL −0.02 from the s167 value so near-white text.onInteractive clears AA with margin (measured 4.61:1, sRGB-clipped).

hover.$description: Hover tracks new baseline with ΔL −0.06 / ΔC +0.01 guardrails.

pressed.$description: Pressed deepens luminance (ΔL −0.12) while keeping hue clamp at 43°.

subtle.$description: Default border tone for cards and inputs.

strong.$description: High-emphasis outline for focus and separators.

outer.$description: Light focus outline uses the full accent text colour to exceed 3:1 against canvas and raised surfaces.

text.$description: Branded light focus text matches the Brand A accent text.

primary.$description: Primary body copy colour achieving ≥12:1 on canvas.

secondary.$description: Secondary text for muted labels and metadata.

accent.$description: Accent text for inline highlights and links. ΔL −0.025 from the s168 value so the pairing with surface.subtle clears AA — that pairing was ungraded until s169 completed the text × panel grid. No ratio is quoted here on purpose: every text.accent claim is graded against the CANVAS pair, so a number about a different surface would be checked against the wrong one.

01.$description: Categorical slot 01 (blue). Inline oklch, decoupled from sys.status.info.icon (s146 F1) — re-spaced so the palette clears min-pairwise ΔE00 ≥ 10 over CVD.

02.$description: Categorical slot 02 (indigo). Inline oklch, decoupled from sys.status.accent.icon (s146 F1).

03.$description: Categorical slot 03 (green). Inline oklch, decoupled from sys.status.success.icon (s146 F1).

04.$description: Categorical slot 04 (gold). Lightness reduced by 0.007 at fixed hue/chroma for >=3:1 on both light canvases (s191-m01). Inline oklch, decoupled from sys.status.warning.icon (s146 F1).

05.$description: Categorical slot 05 (red). Inline oklch, decoupled from sys.status.critical.icon (s146 F1).

06.$description: Categorical slot 06 (rust). Inline oklch, decoupled from sys.status.neutral.icon and re-chromatized from the old near-gray slate (s146 F1 Q3) — a distinct warm hue that stays CVD-separable from slots 01-05.
